server.name: io.github.chrischall/infinitecampus-mcp
server.description: Infinite Campus (Campus Parent) for Claude — grades, attendance, assignments, messages

environmentVariables.description: Campus Parent portal base URL, e.g. https://campus.district.k12.example.us
environmentVariables.name: IC_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Infinite Campus district app name (appName path segment from the portal URL)
environmentVariables.name: IC_DISTRICT

environmentVariables.description: Campus Parent portal username. Optional: leave unset to use the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback.
environmentVariables.name: IC_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Campus Parent portal password. Required only when IC_USERNAME is set.
environmentVariables.name: IC_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Friendly name for the district (defaults to district appname)
environmentVariables.name: IC_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).
environmentVariables.name: IC_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: IC_SESSION_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.infinitecampus-mcp/session-<district>.json.
environmentVariables.name: IC_SESSION_FILE

server.name: io.github.chrischall/kiaaccess-mcp
server.description: Kia Access for Claude — vehicle status, location, doors, climate, and charging

environmentVariables.description: Your Kia Owners Portal / Kia Access account email address.
environmentVariables.name: KIA_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Your Kia Owners Portal / Kia Access account password.
environmentVariables.name: KIA_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no vehicle commands; "comfort" registers climate and charging only; "all" adds door lock/unlock (default "comfort"). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".
environmentVariables.name: KIA_WRITE_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Optional stable device UUID used for the app login handshake. Generated and cached under ~/.kiaaccess-mcp/ when omitted.
environmentVariables.name: KIA_DEVICE_ID
